title: Kosh AEO Report
description: Schema for the kosh AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) / AI Mode analysis report. Evaluates a WordPress site the way AI tools do — crawling, parsing structure, extracting entities, and deciding whether to cite it in a generated answer. Evaluation-based (pass/partial/fail/na per signal), no numerical scoring.

url.description: The homepage URL that was analyzed.

websiteName.description: Site name extracted from Organization schema, og:site_name, the WordPress site title, or page title.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was run.

aeoRubricVersion.description: Version of the AEO evaluation rubric used for this analysis. Format: major.minor (e.g. 1.0). Major bumps when signals are added, removed, or have their evaluation criteria fundamentally changed; minor bumps when tier definitions or rationale are refined within an existing signal.

environment.description: Environment the site was running in during the test. Determined from $ARGUMENTS or inferred from the URL. Defaults to production.

siteType.description: Detected site type, set in Phase 0. Drives how the generalized content-quality signals are evaluated (whoWhatWho, primaryFocusSpecificity, primaryOfferingDetail, namedSpecificEntities, namedSubjectAreas, recentFeaturedWork). Schema-related signals are evaluated against the content-driven applicableSchemas map, not the siteType. Default is 'other' when detection is ambiguous.

siteTypeConfidence.description: Confidence in the site type detection. high = unambiguous (schema markup explicitly identifies the type or content overwhelmingly matches); medium = strong but mixed signals; low = ambiguous, scored against the 'other' default-by-evidence path.

siteTypeRationale.description: Short explanation of the evidence used to determine the site type (e.g., 'WooCommerce shop schema + 47 Product pages in sitemap').

visitedPages.description: URLs of every page visited during the analysis. The homepage is the primary evaluation target; inner pages provide supporting evidence (named team, blog freshness, FAQ structure, canonical URLs, content update recency, author bylines, archive-page quality). Typically 4-6 entries. Single-page sites are an allowed exception — cap at the homepage URL only; the per-signal `notes` field on `recentFeaturedWork`, `currentDomainReferences`, etc. captures the N/A rationale.

summary.description: Top-level counts of signal evaluation results across all 49 signals.

totalSignals.description: Total number of signals evaluated. Locked to 49 by rubric 1.0 — every signal in the canonical key list must be present in the `criteria` block, so this rolls up to a fixed value. If the rubric version changes, update this const alongside.

pass.description: Signals meeting the highest tier of their evaluation criteria.

partial.description: Signals meeting a middle tier — present but incomplete, or correct but sparse.

fail.description: Signals not meeting any tier — absent, broken, or fundamentally wrong.

na.description: Signals not applicable to this site (e.g., authorBylines on a pure-ecommerce site with no editorial content). Recorded as N/A with rationale in notes.

technicalHealth.description: Crawlability, HTTPS, robots.txt, sitemap, JS dependency, canonical URLs.

structuredData.description: Schema markup, OG tags, schema relevance coverage.

aeoReadiness.description: Answer Engine Optimization — FAQ, question headings, direct answers, answer capsules, title/meta question-match.

contentFreshness.description: Copyright year, blog recency, date stamps, sitemap lastmod, per-page update recency.

entityClarity.description: Named entity identification, primary focus specificity, geographic clarity.

contentSpecificity.description: Named platforms, industries, outcomes, and passage extractability.

llmsTxt.description: llms.txt and llms-full.txt presence and quality.

critical.description: Foundational signals at status 'fail'. Blocking AI discoverability or citation.

high.description: Important signals at status 'fail', or foundational signals at status 'partial'. Significantly weakens AI understanding.

medium.description: Signals at status 'partial' on non-foundational signals. Improvement opportunity.

low.description: Minor gaps. Worth noting but low priority.

actionablePrompts.description: One entry per signal at status 'fail' or 'partial'. Each includes a ready-to-use Claude prompt the site owner can paste directly.

technicalNotes.description: Technical findings from HTTP fetches and browser inspection.

robotsTxt.description: URL fetched and short summary of AI crawler access rules found.

sitemapUrl.description: Sitemap URL found, or empty/'not found'.

javascriptRequired.description: Whether core homepage content requires JavaScript to render.

cmsDetected.description: Detected CMS (e.g. 'WordPress', 'WordPress + Yoast', 'WordPress + RankMath', 'Headless'). Used by the skill to tune effort estimates.

schemaFormats.description: Counts of structured-data formats present on the homepage. JSON-LD is preferred for AI parsing; microdata and RDFa earn partial credit on the structured-data signals.

rdfa.description: Count of [typeof] elements inside a vocab="http://schema.org/" or compatible prefix scope.

applicableSchemas.description: Phase 0.4 schema relevance map. Keys are the 11 schema.org type names the AEO skill evaluates; values describe how relevant each schema is to the site's actual content. Drives primaryEntitySchema and relevantSchemasApplied evaluation.

status.description: Evaluation status. pass = meets the highest tier of the signal's criteria. partial = meets a middle tier (present but incomplete, or correct but sparse). fail = meets the bottom tier (absent, broken, or fundamentally wrong). na = signal does not apply to this site (e.g., authorBylines on a pure-ecommerce site).

notes.description: Short evidence sentence describing what was found and why this status was assigned.

schemaRelevance.description: How relevant this schema.org type is to the site's actual content (Phase 0.4 detection). high = clearly applicable + content pattern is prominent. medium = some applicable content but secondary. low = one-off mention or weak pattern. absent = no content the schema would describe.

criterionKey.description: Canonical criterion key — the 8 keys the criteria block uses. Issue and actionablePrompt entries reference this enum to keep findings keyed on the same names criterionLabel() looks up.

signalKey.description: Canonical signal key — one of the 49 keys listed in skills/aeo/references/signal-keys.md. Issue and actionablePrompt entries reference this enum so typos fail validation instead of rendering as raw keys via signalLabel()'s fallback.

criterionSignalPairing.description: Discriminated union enforcing that the criterion + signal pair belongs together. Each variant fixes the criterion key and restricts the signal to that criterion's canonical subset, so `{ criterion: 'llmsTxt', signal: 'canonicalUrls' }` fails validation instead of rendering as a nonsense finding. Used by both `issue` and `actionablePrompt` via `allOf`.

criterion.description: Canonical criterion key (one of the 8 enum values).

signal.description: Canonical signal key (one of the 49 enum values). Must belong to the criterion above — see `criterionSignalPairing`.

issue.description: One sentence describing the specific gap found on this site.

impact.description: One sentence explaining the consequence for AI discoverability or citation.

effort.description: Implementation effort estimate. low = content edit or simple config change, no developer required (under 1 hour). medium = requires a developer, plugin, or significant content creation (hours to a day). high = requires design or development work, refactoring, or substantial content creation (days or more). unknown = stack context insufficient to assess.

effortRationale.description: Optional. Short site-specific note explaining why this effort rating was assigned, e.g. 'WordPress with Yoast detected — one-field edit in the SEO panel'. Only include when site context meaningfully changes the baseline.

pages.description: Optional. URLs of pages where this issue was observed. Used for inner-page findings (FAQ structure, dated posts, etc.).

criterion.description: Canonical criterion key (one of the 8 enum values).

signal.description: Canonical signal key (one of the 49 enum values). Must belong to the criterion above — see `criterionSignalPairing`.

issue.description: Specific issue found on this site.

impact.description: One sentence explaining the impact on AI discoverability or citation.

prompt.description: Ready-to-use Claude prompt the site owner can paste directly.
